thread:
maria: quick q — where's the single-panel view for GPU SM% + KV cache hitrate? trying to correlate with the batch size change I rolled yesterday
aj: there's a prefab in Grafana, but direct link is easier: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/abcd123/gpu-insights?orgId=1&view=sm_kv
devon: for traces you'll want Jaeger: https://jaeger.redwood.com/search?service=inference-gpu — filter by trace span `serve_request` 
aj: note — KV cache metrics live under `model_serving.kvcache.*` not `gpu.*`. KV hitrate: `model_serving_kvcache_hitrate`
maria: thanks. any quick guesses why SM% jumped ~20% around 03:40? I increased max_batch from 8 -> 12 on canary around then
sre-oncall: can you paste the deploy id and the canary pool? I'll check host churn and allocation logs
maria: deploy id: `canary-2026-03-16-1421`, pool: `pool-gpu-3`
observability-bot: Alert triggered: `gpu-sm-utilization-high` on `pool-gpu-3` at 1943210105 — severity: warning — alert: https://alerts.redwood.com/alerts/1943210105
kai: FYI that alert is currently set to 85% sustained over 5m — increasing batch could push sustained utilization. also check p99 latency impact
aj: to debug start with these quick queries in Explore: 
```
sum(avg_over_time(gpu_sm_utilization_percent[5m])) by (instance)
model_serving_kvcache_hitrate{model=~".*-v2"}
rate(model_serving_kvcache_evictions_total[5m])
```
and look at `device_memory_used_bytes` + `device_memory_total_bytes` panels
maria: running them now, will post screenshots in a sec
devon: also lookup node-level OOM/kube events over the same window. if mem pressure caused task migrations SM% can spike
maria: quick results: SM% up on two instances, kv hitrate dropped ~8% at same time, evictions spiked — screenshots attached (omitted here)
aj: that looks like cache thrash — more batching + smaller per-request KV locality could cause more evictions. for canary maybe cap max_batch to 10 while we investigate
sre-oncall: proposal: change alert to require 10m sustained at 87% or keep 5m at 90%? which reduces noise without missing regressions
aj: prefer increasing duration to 10m first, then revisit threshold after we collect p99 latency across the canary/primary split
observability-bot: Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.com/gpu-sm-high — recommends: check evictions, memory, batch params, fallback to lower batch
sre-oncall: I'll open a PR to adjust the alert duration and add runbook link to the rule. assigning to @aj for review
maria: great, please ping when it's merged; also @devon can you review my batching README change? small note about default `max_batch` behaviour
devon: will review this afternoon and leave comments
maria: thanks all :thumbsup:
